rationale: The candidate reads as a coherent compact neighborhood-living mass in all four views, not just one. It has one dominant continuous body with a clear hierarchy: a heavier upper volume on a smaller lifted/porous base, plus a legible carved/offset ground response toward the frontage edge. The top and axon views confirm the same footprint logic, so there is no obvious cross-view collision or incoherent fragmenting. The silhouette is stepped but not merely code-minimum stair stacking; the steps participate in a single massing gesture and the program can plausibly occupy it as mixed neighborhood living with active ground relationship and upper calmness. The void is present but modest rather than emphatic, so it is program-adequate but not exceptional. The form resonates with the supplied neighborhood references through courtyard/void, low-rise horizontal spread, and lifted or terraced articulation, while remaining distinct. No major repair is needed beyond preserving the dominant gesture and potentially strengthening the public void if further refinement is desired.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More pavilion-like and sculptural than the candidate; do not copy the curved roof language directly.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Three-part low-rise mass with a central void and a lifted connector can create a clear public threshold without fragmenting the whole.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: Much larger and more dispersed than the candidate; the tower elements are not transferable here.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Campus-like composition around a generous central open space supports neighborhood program through courtyard legibility and stepped low-rise masses.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: More box-like and urban-hall-like; the candidate already has more spatial complexity.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: A single rectangular body can be made program-fit by carving a strong void and overhanging the upper volume above an active ground zone.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: References a broader campus strip; do not over-spread the candidate.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Elongated low-rise massing with a courtyard void and folded roof can create an active mixed-use figure that stays horizontally grounded.

reference_assessments.mismatch_warning: This is more spread out and connective; the candidate should remain more compact.
reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Terraced, connected wings and a legible central public space can preserve neighborhood identity while keeping the ground plane active.

warnings: Parcel containment appears acceptable from the visible green boundary; no deterministic hard-gate failure detected.
The access response is legible but could be more publicly generous if the design intent is to emphasize a stronger street threshold.
